template_data.lead_html: From "my rates are too high" to a federal pricing narrative.

rows.what_html: The fear surfaces — eight years in business, convinced the government won't accept his commercial rates
Defensible beats cheapest — match your Schedule rate to your most-favorable commercial price and document it
$3.7B in Q3 construction awards — the obstacle wasn't his rates; it was his belief about them

template_data.closer: THE PRICING FEAR IS ALMOST NEVER THE ACTUAL OBSTACLE.
